payload.description: This Implementation phase's single permitted transport-only correction attempt was already used on the first turn (pre_test_requested, attempt 1 -> attempt 2), which succeeded. A second, independent transport violation then occurred on the following turn (post_test_requested, attempt 3: leading prose plus a Markdown fence). Per work/SKILL.md's Engineer transport repair protocol, the one-correction budget is shared across the whole phase, not reset per turn, so no second correction request was sent. The phase is blocked.
